title: Remote-first versus office-first policy
goal: A public agency can compare policy trade-offs before hybrid-work planning.

rubric.must: Remote-first and Office-first appear as parallel option columns.
Commute, collaboration, hiring, and workspace-cost rows are visibly compared.
Partial and yes/no distinctions are visually visible.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the comparison/matrix exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows the policy title, parallel Remote-first and Office-first columns, and all four requested comparison rows. Text values and yes/partial/no symbols are visible and readable, with no material overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: Remote-first and Office-first appear as parallel option columns.
Commute burden, informal collaboration, geographic hiring, and workspace cost are all compared.
Informal collaboration is marked partial for Remote-first and yes for Office-first; hiring is marked yes and no, respectively. The legend identifies each symbol.
The comparison grid and its labels and values are readable.
The title “Remote-first versus office-first policy” is visible.
